messages:
Maria Chen: FYI customer Helion's LoRA merge is mangling numeric invoices in int4 run — getting dropped digits and punctuation repeats on our quick smoke set.
Lee Park: oh no. which tokenizer variant are they using?
Maria Chen: helion-tokenizer-v2 (custom merges). Repro on 6/60 smoke prompts. Example below.
Jonah V: paste the raw token ids too so we can see alignment.
Maria Chen: example: 
```
prompt: "Invoice
Total: $3,210.00
List items..."
model: base-4bit + helion-lora-v1 (merged.pt)
decoded: "Invoice
Total: ,,,.
Items:"
raw ids: [1012, 342, 342, 342, 88, ...]
```
Ciara O'Neill: looks like token id 342 maps to comma in one vocab and to digits in the other. run `tools/vocab_diff.py --base base_vocab.json --patch adapter_vocab.json --show 5`.
Maria Chen: ran it, output snippet: 
```
# vocab_diff
base id 342 -> "1"
adapter id 342 -> ","
```
Lee Park: that explains it. The adapter was merged without preserving id space. Which merge command did you run?
Maria Chen: `scripts/merge_adapter.sh --base base.pt --adapter helion_lora.pt --out merged.pt` (default flags).
Jonah V: try `--preserve-id-map` switch (our merge tool sets adapter weights to align to base ids rather than adapter-local ids).
Maria Chen: re-merged with `--preserve-id-map` and kicked off quickpack (10 synthetic invoices, batch=12, int4+kq8). ops-bot queued it.
ops-bot: queued job #8502 quickpack-helion-4250000001 on rtx-a100-pool
Lee Park: good. Also run the merged_vs_preserve A/B and compute exact_amount_match + token-dup-rate.
Ciara O'Neill: I'll grab the numbers once job finishes.
ops-bot: job #8502 finished: merged_default -> exact_amount_match 65/100, token_dup_rate 0.14; merged_preserve -> exact_amount_match 97/100, token_dup_rate 0.02
Maria Chen: nice improvement. Repro confirms root cause is id-space mismatch.
Jonah V: action items: 1) Add a pre-merge check that diffs top-k token id mappings and warns when >1% of overlap mismatches. 2) Add a small CI quickpack that runs 8 synthetic invoice prompts when a merge touches tokenizer files.
Lee Park: I'll draft a 1-page RFC for the pre-merge hook and link to `tools/vocab_diff.py`.
Ciara O'Neill: I'll add the CI test to adapter-merge job and assert exact_amount_match >= 95% for the synthetic set.
Maria Chen: Opening PR with test + docs note about `--preserve-id-map` and the vocab_diff steps.
Lee Park: thanks — marking resolved here unless we see other regressions.
Maria Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
